title: Recommendation Feedback (feedback.jsonl record)
description: One JSON object per line in outputs/feedback.jsonl, exactly as written by save_feedback() in the local interface. Feedback is local-only and is aggregated by generate_recommendations.py to gently nudge future scoring.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp written when the reaction was saved.

action.description: The reaction. 'like'/'more_like_this' boost the track's genres and artist; 'not_for_me' lowers them; 'too_similar'/'too_strange' shift the novelty distance.

track_title.description: Title of the recommended track the reaction applies to.

artist.description: Artist of the recommended track (used for artist-level feedback weighting).

genres.description: Genres of the track (used for genre-level feedback weighting).

group.description: Group the track was shown in (safe_match, adjacent_discovery, wildcard).

mood.description: Mood score active during the run.

experimentality.description: Experimentality (novelty) level active during the run.

source.description: Source label of the run (e.g. demo library, Spotify, upload).

reason.description: Optional free-text note explaining the reaction.
